summary: The Dominion Heartlands are the central homeland of the Muramite Empire — a vast territory of disciplined military culture, fortified settlements, and industrial war‑forges. It is the birthplace of Muramite warlords and the foundation of their planar conquests.
history: Muramite clans unified here under the first Imperator.
The Legion Barracks became the training grounds for Muramite soldiers.
Dominion Lowlands developed into the agricultural and logistical backbone of the empire.
Warlord Court emerged as the political center of Muramite hierarchy.
The Heartforge Complex became the industrial engine of Muramite war production.
